description: Apply an externally provided UI to an application, compare the result against a pre-apply snapshot to catch dropped behavior, then review and validate the resulting feature metadata.
name: apply ui

parameters.description: Path to the source UI: a screenshot directory, HTML/JSX file, template repo root, or written redesign spec
parameters.name: source

configJson.command: if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo "refusing to run apply-ui: working tree has uncommitted changes, and HEAD is the parity reference" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -e .worktrees/ui-reference ]; then echo "refusing to run apply-ui: .worktrees/ui-reference already exists (leftover from an aborted run?); inspect it, then 'git worktree remove .worktrees/ui-reference' before rerunning" >&2; exit 1; fi; git worktree prune; git worktree add --detach .worktrees/ui-reference HEAD

postHookJson.command: git worktree remove --force .worktrees/ui-reference; git worktree prune
